cleanup_query: match $robot isa robot, has full-name "{key}"; delete $robot isa robot;

queries.query: insert $robot isa robot, has full-name "{key}", has robot-type "stress", has age {cycle}, has alive true;
match $robot isa robot, has full-name "{key}", has age $age; delete $robot has $age; insert $robot has age {cycle_plus_one};
match $robot isa robot, has full-name "{key}"; delete $robot isa robot;
